majority_vote.label: Majority Vote
majority_vote.short: Uses the most common prediction across all models.

local_best_model.label: Local Best Model
local_best_model.short: Picks the single model with the best local performance.

preference_weighted_best_model.label: Preference-Weighted Best
preference_weighted_best_model.short: Picks the model with the highest score under your criteria weights.

weighted_vote_fixed.label: Weighted Vote
weighted_vote_fixed.short: Averages model probabilities, weighted by criterion scores.

abstain_or_defer.label: Abstain / Defer
abstain_or_defer.short: Defers to a human when models disagree too much.
